about: Country corpus for job-board .102 (17 names, Wien, S14X-249, S14X-120, ThePlace1), built 2026-11-15. Labels never come from the rule under test. kind 'sr': SmartRecruiters rows from the 1,466-feed capture (post-deploy-c4a29736/theplace1/feeds) and the n1392 fixture, read by smartRecruitersCountry; the label is the vendor's location.country, except the three rows whose basis names the coordinates or postal code that overrule it. kind 'vendor': Lever, Workable, Breezy and iCIMS rows from board-stream-2026-11-01's 18,054-row corpus, read by vendorCountry or icimsCountry; the label is the feed's own country code. kind 'text': every distinct location string, from the live reads behind trust-pages-country/location-corpus.json, trust-round3-country/town-corpus.json, posting-country-corpus-2026-10-25.json and a 2026-11-15 list read, that the .102 reader answers differently from fix/cost-wave b2903605, read by detectCountry; the label is the vendor's code where a feed states one, otherwise a hand label of the place the posting's own words name (a posting in several countries is labelled with each), with the row that carried it. The named negatives are the spec's. main = the reading of fix/cost-wave b2903605.
scoring: A reading equal to the label, or one of a several-country label, is right; none is none; anything else is wrong.
